listX.text: [L15-L39, L484-L485] (HIGH/pointer-state) Pointer components have no default NULL initialization, yet ASSOCIATED is called on fobs1 before any guaranteed association-status definition.

[L2569-L2574] (HIGH/sign inconsistency) The 3D V predictor forms its surface-slope coefficient with zs(i,j)-zs(i,j+1), the opposite orientation to both its bottom term and the analogous U-direction expression.
[L3013-L3021] (HIGH/staggered-field mix-up) The lower-layer V-velocity friction calculation uses s%cfu rather than the V-point friction field s%cfv.
[L3031-L3041] (HIGH/staggered-index mix-up) The V-point corrector averages wcoef(i,j) with wcoef(i+1,j), using an x neighbor where the V staggering calls for the j+1 neighbor.

[L3307-L3327] (MED/parameter-domain contract) nonh_init_wcoef accepts an unconstrained explicit dispc and computes the optimized value through a denominator that is neither checked nor bounded, despite downstream singularities at endpoint or invalid coefficients.
[L3453-L3465] (LOW/iteration termination) disper iterates solely on an error tolerance with no iteration cap or invalid-input guard, leaving termination dependent on unstated positive finite inputs.

[L3403-L3414] (MED/one-dimensional indexing) For ny<=2 the V-point free surface is filled from one fixed zs column (column 2 when present) for every j, rather than from the matching column, and the special-case intent is unclear.

listY.text: [L201-L247] (LOW/unchecked selector) Any ipredcor value other than zero silently selects the correction path, so an invalid selector is accepted as a valid corrector request.

[L288-L372,L453-L455,L961-L963,L1655-L1659,L2479-L2483] (MED/initialization lifecycle) The one-layer routines lazily initialize module storage, but the reduced two-layer predictor paths do not, leaving their correctness dependent on an undocumented external nonh_init call.

[L290-L356] (MED/reinitialization/configuration lifecycle) nonh_init allocates module arrays unconditionally and never supports cleanup, resizing, or changing nonhq3d mode during a later model lifecycle.
[L323-L347] (MED/unchecked grid denominator) The original formulation constructs reciprocal grid spacings without checking for zero or invalid ds/dn metrics.

[L556-L558,L1138-L1157,L1176-L1187,L1254-L1258] (MED/depth denominator contract) Several one-layer pressure, advection, viscosity, and explicit-pressure terms divide by hh based on nonhZ rather than an explicit positive-depth check, relying on the mask contract to guarantee a safe depth.
[L758-L781] (HIGH/wrong-variable typo) In the 1-D excluded-point bottom boundary calculation, dzb_w is assigned dzs_e instead of dzb_e, mixing free-surface and bed slopes.

[L824-L841] (HIGH/wrong-variable typo) In the 2-D excluded-point surface condition, the both-wet V branch assigns dzs_n=dzb_s rather than dzs_s, injecting a bed-slope value into the surface condition.
[L853-L882] (HIGH/wrong-variable typo) In the 2-D excluded-point bottom condition, the both-wet U branch assigns dzb_w=dzs_e rather than dzb_e.

[L1172-L1177] (HIGH/directional coefficient mismatch) The y-direction vertical-viscosity flux uses s%hu at lines 1174-1175 even though it is evaluated across V faces, unlike the expected y-face depth s%hv.

[L1371-L1383,L1453-L1484,L2048-L2150,L2244-L2284] (MED/stale interpolated geometry) Both reduced correctors claim to recalculate zsu/zsv/zbu/zbv but contain no zuzv call, so matrix and kinematic corrections use geometry last computed in the predictor.

[L1694-L1720,L1912-L1925,L2546-L2599,L2968-L3031] (HIGH/singular layer-fraction formulas) Reduced-layer formulas divide by 1-wcoef, 2-wcoef sums, and nhlay-nhlay^2 while only checking nhlay>0, so nhlay/wcoef equal or near one makes the system singular.
[L2362-L2374] (HIGH/MPI boundary indexing) The xmpi_isleft branch assigns Wm(1,:) instead of Wm(:,1), overwriting the top x row and leaving the left y boundary unset.

[L2494-L2497] (HIGH/wrong adjacent layer coefficient) The 3-D U-pressure east coefficient uses wcoef(i,j) for the i+1 cell, inconsistent with its hh(i+1,j), the 2-DV implementation, and the analogous V coefficient.

[L2544-L2550,L2571-L2575] (MED/directional sign inconsistency) The dV pressure correction forms surface and wcoef differences as current-minus-next while dU uses next-minus-current, despite the base U/V pressure gradients sharing the same orientation.
[L3013-L3046] (HIGH/wrong directional friction data) The dV bottom-friction update uses s%cfu rather than the V-face friction coefficient and averages wcoef across i/i+1 rather than j/j+1.

[L3311-L3319,L3420-L3465] (MED/unbounded/singular dispersion solve) wcoef initialization does not validate Topt, and disper has singular arithmetic for zero frequency/depth plus an iteration with no maximum-count or stagnation guard.

[L3369-L3401] (MED/MPI halo initialization) On non-bottom MPI ranks zbu(nx+1,:) and zsu(nx+1,:) are not assigned or exchanged by zuzv, although nonh mask construction iterates through nx+1 and reads zbu there.

listX.text: [L116-L119,L305,L314-L315,L372-L373] (MED/degenerate-grid input) Ship-grid dx and dy permit zero, yet they define all coordinates and the cell area passed to grmap2, so a configured zero spacing creates a collapsed mapping grid.

[L98-L145,L172-L176,L223-L258] (MED/lifecycle/allocation) ship_init allocates the ship pointer graph and global ship arrays without an allocated/associated guard or teardown, making repeated initialization unsafe.

[L167-L176,L208-L217] (HIGH/out-of-bounds input case) A track with fewer than two records is accepted by count_lines, but automatic heading calculation unconditionally accesses records 1 and 2 and the final record minus one.

[L130-L163,L330-L368] (HIGH/uninitialized hull state) When compute_motion is enabled, zhull is not initialized, yet shipwave reads it to compute pressure before the later placeholder motion update; with compute_force disabled it is never updated at all.

[L223-L240,L339-L350] (HIGH/uninitialized motion state) shipphi, shipchi, and shippsi are allocated but not initialized, while the unimplemented motion branch immediately uses shipchi and shipphi to position the hull.

[L210-L216,L297-L304] (MED/angular interpolation) Heading is represented as a wrapped angle and then interpolated linearly without unwrap handling, so tracks crossing the angle branch cut can rotate through the long arc.

[L278,L403-L410] (MED/saved lifecycle state) The saved firstship flag is cleared permanently after one call and has no reset path, so a subsequent simulation in the same process will skip its required initial surface adjustment.

[L314-L315,L348-L350,L442-L446] (HIGH/coordinate-frame inconsistency) Hull rotation and force moments subtract ship-local xCG/yCG values from globally positioned x/y coordinates, causing lever arms and rotated elevations to depend on the domain origin.
[L314-L315] (LOW/integer-centering ambiguity) The local-grid origin uses integer division nx/2 and ny/2, producing an asymmetric set of coordinates for odd grid dimensions.

[L101-L107,L149-L156,L169-L206] (LOW/file-error handling) Ship-list, geometry, and track opens and reads have no visible status checks here, so malformed or short input depends entirely on helper-side termination behavior.

listY.text: [L116-L119,L305,L314-L315,L372-L373] (MED/degenerate geometry input) dx and dy accept zero even though they define ship-grid coordinates and the area supplied to grmap2, allowing a degenerate mapping grid.

[L167-L176,L210-L216] (HIGH/unchecked input length) When heading is derived, the code unconditionally accesses track samples 1 and 2 (and the final sample's predecessor), so a track with fewer than two records is out of bounds.

[L130-L160,L330-L358] (HIGH/uninitialized hull state) For compute_motion=1, zhull is allocated but not initialized before it is used to compute pressure and force; the hull geometry update occurs only afterward.

[L223-L240,L346-L350] (HIGH/uninitialized motion state) shipphi, shipchi, and shippsi are allocated without initialization, while shipphi and shipchi are consumed during the first motion-enabled hull update.

[L297-L304] (MED/angular interpolation) Heading is linearly interpolated as an ordinary scalar after conversion to radians, with no unwrap handling for tracks that cross the 0/360-degree discontinuity.

[L278,L403-L410] (LOW/cross-instance persistent state) The saved firstship flag is never reset by ship_init, so a second model lifecycle in the same process will skip its initial water-level adjustment.
[L314-L315] (LOW/grid centering) Integer division nx/2 and ny/2 makes odd-sized ship grids asymmetric about the declared center of gravity.

[L346-L350,L442-L443] (HIGH/coordinate-frame inconsistency) World-coordinate ship-grid positions are combined with ship-local xCG/yCG when computing hull rotations and roll/pitch moments, making results depend on the global coordinate origin.

[L333-L358] (MED/time-level inconsistency) For motion-enabled ships, pressure forces are computed from the previous hull position and only then is zhull updated, creating a one-step geometry/force lag even after initialization.

[L434-L446] (LOW/quadrature inconsistency) Vertical force uses only ph(ix,iy) per panel while horizontal forces average edge pressures, introducing a directional inconsistency in pressure integration.

listX.text: [L26-L35, L49-L81, L157-L160, L481-L486, L744-L748] (LOW/lifecycle/state) Module-global work arrays are allocated only once and have no resize or teardown path, so reuse with a different grid shape leaves an incompatible saved allocation.

[L360-L366, L760-L766, L785-L791, L806-L807, L922-L930] (HIGH/grid-metric/indexing) Multiple two-dimensional correction formulas hard-code the transverse metric index to 1 even though neighboring code uses the current i or j, making the scheme inconsistent on spatially varying curvilinear grids.

[L784-L792] (HIGH/numerical-sign) The negative-v qy continuity branch omits the sign reversal used by the corresponding negative-u branch and by the other second-order flux routines, yielding a correction with the opposite sign.

[L751-L772, L774-L800, L802-L819] (HIGH/MPI-boundary) The continuity correction is computed with fixed whole-array loops and then unconditionally zeroes every local outer work-array edge without MPI-aware exchange or boundary tests, so subdomain-interface corrections can be discarded and the update can depend on decomposition.

listY.text: [L622-L676] (HIGH/stale-work-array) The 1-D vertical-momentum path does not clear wrk1 globally and cycles inactive mask cells before zeroing them, so a flux left from an earlier call can enter an active neighbor's divergence.

[L784-L792] (HIGH/sign-inconsistency) The negative-v continuity correction lacks the leading minus used by the analogous negative-u branch, making the qy correction's sign inconsistent with the qx implementation.

[L359-L366] (MED/grid-metric-indexing) Cross-advection of v uses s%dsu(...,1) throughout a two-dimensional loop and the first negative-flow gradient uses dsu(ie,1) for the i-to-ie interval, which is inconsistent with local curvilinear spacing.

[L751-L791, L802-L813] (MED/grid-metric-indexing) The continuity correction repeatedly fixes the unused metric coordinate at 1 (dsu(i,1), dnv(1,j), dsz(i,1), dnz(1,j)), despite the module claiming curvilinear support and looping over the full 2-D grid.

[L291-L303, L378-L379, L612, L676] (MED/division-precondition) Second-order velocity corrections divide by hum, hvm, or hh without a local positive-depth guard at the update point; the broader stencil mindepth check does not protect every update path.

[L49-L80, L157-L160] (LOW/lifecycle-contract) Module work arrays are allocated once with the first grid shape and have no reinitialization or shape check, so repeated library initialization with a different grid would retain incompatible storage.

[L509, L552, L633] (LOW/mask-contract) Neighbor masks are multiplied and used as a real flux factor rather than reduced logically, so the code silently assumes mskZ values are strictly binary rather than merely zero/nonzero.
